title: It seems like a pretty good app.
body: I haven’t used this app a lot yet, but it has no bugs so far, and the design looks really good. I think it could have some more functions without the subscription for the new users to try.
author: ThCili

title: Great app
body: My experience with the app has been very positive so far. I like that it motivates me to reach my daily goals and helps me track my progress. The app is easy to use, and the interface is modern and clear. I hope it adds even more features in the future.
author: DMN1122

title: Scam
body: Never give  credit card details, they keep on charging even if you cancel.
author: Elly8787

title: Good app
body:
Its a pretty good app. I really enjoyed how easy it was to add habits and track them. Very nice to see them organized like that. I find the basic non-paid version to be plenty, it’s all I need really. 

One tiny thing is that the sound it makes when you click anything is really annoying, please fix. 

Will be using in the future!
author: YllMusliu1

title: It’s a great app
body: If your trying to get yourself together, I really recommend this app. Very well made and also you can track every single habit that you didn’t even thought of.
author: TotoSilvetti

title: Nice app
body: Very cool application. All kinds of habits and routines can be added to my day. I like that all kinds of help are available for self-development.
author: BenceK17

title: Cheater!
body: Beware this is a scam! I have been trying to cancel my subscription for two months. They promised it would be deleted, yet fhey charging my credit card!
author: Z.Bence89

title: Eterna
body: It is useless for me. Trying to cancel since a month, don’t get correct answer, meanwhile they are trying to get the fee from my account, although I notified on time that I will not prolong subscription. Simple cheating without costumer service, be aware of this app.
author: Nussanto

title: Totally useless and incorrect costumer service!
body: It is a totally useless app. I bought it, but it has charged my credit card again, but I didn't want to continue the subscription. When I bought it, life time access was advertised. It's a scam and customer service was not helpful at all! The wrong subscription will not be refunded for the second year! Instead, they recommended a course, which is completely unacceptable to me as I have absolutely no interest in the founder's course. I'd be more interested in the $70, which I didn't want to pay again. They refer to the general contract. Typical customer damaging attitude. I DO NOT RECOMMEND TO ANYONE!
author: Pussyfish

title: First day of week to Monday?
body: How to set week start to Monday instead of Sunday??? Best app for habit development, but please let week start on Monday like in most countries
